verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs say every session has a live view URL for watching the agent browse in real time. They also say the user can "take over and interact with the browser yourself", which covers both live watching and mid-run human control. The takeover capability rests on a single sentence, and its mechanics are not documented. missing for 10: details on how takeover pauses the agent and hands control back, any stuck-agent handoff or alert trigger, independent or hands-on corroboration of takeover working.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: Every session comes with a live view URL where you can watch your agent browse in real-time. You can also take over and interact with the browser yourself.
When running a task, you will receive a `live_url`, which can be used to view the agent actions live.
